faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Mitsitsy

availability.question: Is the app available now?
availability.answer: Yes! Mitsitsy is available now on Google Play Store for Android. Download it for free and start tracking your expenses in 10 seconds.

free.question: Is the app free?
free.answer: Yes. Mitsitsy is free, with no ads. An optional Premium version with cloud sync is coming later, but the basic app will always remain free.

offline.question: Can I use the app without internet?
offline.answer: Absolutely. That's our main difference. Mitsitsy works entirely offline. Recording, viewing, charts - everything works without internet.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes. All your data is stored locally on your phone in a secure SQLite database. No data is sent to external servers. We don't have access to your financial information.

currencies.question: Which currencies are supported?
currencies.answer: Malagasy Ariary (MGA), Euro (EUR), and US Dollar (USD) with automatic currency conversion included.

platforms.question: On which platforms is the app available?
platforms.answer: Mitsitsy is available now on Android (Google Play Store). An iOS version (App Store) is planned for later.

notify.question: How can I hear about what's new?
notify.answer: Sign up for our newsletter above. You'll receive an email whenever something new comes to the app, plus exclusive tips to better manage your money.

planning.question: How does budget planning work?
planning.answer: Create a plan with a target amount and deadline. Add items with their amounts. The app tracks your progress. When ready, convert the plan to real transactions in one tap.
